title: Emerald Breeze | KEY.co
description_expanded: The top-floor entertainment level is a showstopper: a chef’s kitchen with high-end tools, a breakfast bar for four, and a striking wood dining table seating ten, complemented by a dedicated bar with an ice maker, beverage cooler, and seating for four more. Warm lighting, curated textures, and panoramic sunset views create a luxurious yet relaxed ambiance for gathering and unwinding. Sleeping arrangements are thoughtfully laid out, king suites on the first and second floors, a twin-over-full bunk room with en-suite, a third-floor primary king suite, and a two-queen suite, delivering space and comfort for families and groups. Emerald Breeze is a polished sanctuary where effortless convenience meets the beauty of the beach. Emerald Breeze elevates coastal living along 30A with sweeping emerald Gulf vistas from four private balconies and refined comforts throughout. Set in coveted Inlet Beach directly facing the Gulf of Mexico, this three-level retreat pairs privacy with polish—six bedrooms, each with an en-suite bath, two laundry areas, an elevator to every floor, and serene coastal-chic design. Outdoor indulgence comes easy with a private heated pool, plus a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes for effortless beach-town exploring.
